title: STEMEd+ Funding opportunity
description: One funding program that Grants.gov does not cover: a foundation, society, or state or regional program. One file per program in opportunities/.

name.description: Program name as the sponsor gives it.

sponsor.description: Organization that funds or runs it.

url.description: The sponsor's own page for the program.

status.description: open: taking applications now. upcoming: next deadline announced. rolling: any time. between-cycles: recurring, next dates not yet posted. paused: sponsor has paused it. invitation: by invitation or nomination only. no-open-call: no current competition.

deadline_note.description: How the cycle usually runs, in a sentence.

eligibility.description: Who can apply, in a sentence.

summary.description: What it funds, in your own words.

kinds.description: The last three are for teachers and instructors: classroom mini-grants, teaching awards, and support to travel to teaching workshops and conferences or for other professional learning.

disciplines.description: Leave empty for programs open to all STEM+ fields. Labels from the STEMEd+ discipline list (stemed_funding/stemedplus_disciplines.json, kept in HuMeta); the build checks them against that list.

states.description: Two-letter codes for state or regional programs; leave out for national ones.

checked.description: When someone last checked this against the sponsor's page.
